biggest_catch: The friend must earn $25 in qualified cash back within 180 days of signup for you to get the $25 bonus — and the official terms state no bonus for the friend's side; promo signup bonuses don't count toward the $25.
catches: You receive a $25 bonus only when your referral creates a Upromise account and reaches at least $25 in qualified cash back rewards within 180 days of signup.
Only one $25 bonus per referral signup.

'Qualified Rewards' exclude the $5.29 signup bonus, the $25 529 linking bonus, referral program bonuses, scholarship prizes, and other promotional bonuses — your friend must earn $25 from genuine cash back (shopping, dining, travel, surveys).
The official referral terms state no bonus for the friend's side — the friend earns their normal cash back rewards; any public signup bonus is a separate offer, not part of the referral terms.
Sending traffic through paid search ads, domain redirects, pop-unders, or similar manipulations is expressly prohibited.
